name: Pneumatic Retinopexy 3D Physics Lab
summary: Browser 3D visualization of an intraocular gas bubble and retinal anatomy for pneumatic retinopexy education.
description: Interactive educational simulator of a 24 mm globe with a gas bubble and posterior-segment anatomy, built with Three.js and WebGL 2. Controls adjust gas, fill, time and head orientation; the model uses the Bond number, the Young-Laplace relation and a damped second-order bubble response. A reduced-order educational model, not a validated treatment planner.
contains: 3D scene of an intraocular gas bubble and posterior-segment anatomy in a 24 mm globe
controls: gas selection, fill, time, orientation presets, fundus view, retinal breaks
orbit, zoom and pan navigation; needs a browser with WebGL 2 and hardware acceleration
no backend, database, login or API keys
physics: Bond number, Young-Laplace pressure, damped second-order bubble migration
MIT licensed; deployable to Vercel, built with Vite and Node.js 24
